interpretation: The independently processed and DSLR-scanned Noever chart table supports only a coarse speed-tier ordering: neither 50D nor 200T falls below 500T in any disclosed format/scan stratum, and each is strictly higher in multiple strata. Aliasing and scan saturation remain explicit nuisance facts. The table does not distinguish 50D from 200T and does not validate an absolute MTF or executable PSF.
claim_ceiling: Independent single-study ordinal processed-film-plus-scanner support that 50D/200T resolution is not below 500T across six disclosed format/scan strata; not 50D-versus-200T separation, absolute MTF calibration, scanner-independent material truth, colour response, rendering or product evidence.
next_leaf: Seek a second independent processed-film or calibrated scanner observation before compiling any executable VISION3 spatial profile; do not fit the BU11 display TIFFs or convert Table 3 line-pair limits into a PSF.
